C1787.title: Secretation: Leveraging DIDs and VCs for Forgery-Resistant Decentralized Secret Management
C1787.summary: A 2021 IEEE conference paper introduces Secretation, a scheme that uses decentralized identifiers and verifiable credentials to achieve scalable decentralized secret management.
